C0913.title: Nation's First QR Code Cash-Out Case Cracked
C0913.summary: In October 2021, Yangzhou police uncovered a major illegal business operation, marking the country's first QR code cash-out case. The criminal group exploited QR code payment channels to conduct illicit cash-out activities, leading to the arrest of 15 suspects.
